materialized_topology.primary_pseudobulk_rule: Pure non-targeting controls and cells with one unique non-control target gene and no non-targeting guide are aggregated separately within the sole deposited pool. Exact guide families are retained; mixed control-target and multi-gene calls are excluded.

model_applicability.cellot_scgen: May be used only for descriptive training within this CRISPRa source; no independent held-replicate or held-context evaluation exists.
model_applicability.cpa_perturblib: May consume seen CRISPRa perturbation atoms for training only; no held-combination or biological-replicate claim is registered.
model_applicability.gears_genepert_scgpt_perturbation_head: May consume exact gene targets for training or development-visible unseen-target engineering only; the one-pool source cannot supply confirmatory evaluation or replicate uncertainty.
model_applicability.perturbation_native_baselines: Independent baselines may be fitted only as descriptive training checks; target columns are not biological replicates and no outer evaluation endpoint is admitted.

replicate_ancestry_evidence.deposited_objects: One Perturb-seq expression library and one guide-amplicon library are deposited.
replicate_ancestry_evidence.source_identity_boundary: GEO labels the source G4 mESC, whereas the paper describes purified embryonic hepatocytes; embryo and mouse pooling ancestry are not frozen.
replicate_ancestry_evidence.valid_inference: Training or descriptive single-pool summaries only. Cells, guides, target columns, and files are not biological replicates.

release_and_exposure.allowed_use: development-visible training or descriptive raw-count topology only

runtime_receipt.max_rss_accounting: SLURM batch MaxRSS was 0 and extern MaxRSS was 48 KiB; task-level MaxRSS was unavailable.

task_firewalls.gse281160: not a gene-target dataset and never mapped to a nearest gene

terminal_blockers: No independent biological replicate or donor exists, so the source cannot support outer evaluation, uncertainty estimation, or confirmatory claims.
Resolve the G4 mESC versus purified embryonic-hepatocyte source-label discrepancy and freeze embryo or mouse pooling ancestry.
Freeze authoritative Cell Ranger mm39 feature-reference provenance and a rights authority for model-input use or aggregate redistribution.
Keep CRISPRa activation separate from CRISPRi and knockout model tasks and target identities.
